ai_summary: Allcargo Global Limited demonstrated a significant financial turnaround in Q1 FY27, reporting positive EBITDA of INR 33 crores compared to a loss in the prior year, alongside robust revenue growth (20.8% sequentially) and substantial reductions in net losses. This improvement was driven by strong internal initiatives including disciplined cost control, yield management, and AI-led productivity enhancements, which mitigated ongoing headwinds from global geopolitical disruptions impacting trade volumes. While the company still posted a net loss, the positive shift in profitability and strengthening balance sheet through debt reduction indicate an encouraging strategic direction.
